defect: the destination valid qualifier bypasses the destination-domain transaction state
rationale: The data token is synchronized into clk_b, but dst_valid_b is driven directly from src_valid_a and can assert or clear independently of destination readiness and data capture.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: dst_valid_b is the unsynchronised src_valid_a, so the payload qualifier crosses directly and is not aligned with the toggle-synchronised data.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the source data holding register, token transfer, and destination data capture context, reduced the ready/valid state machine, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Drove dst_valid_b directly from src_valid_a instead of the synchronized destination token and destination-side readiness state.
